1. 作为小县城唯一玩过《鸣潮》的人，我的眼神里总是透着同龄人不懂的“漂泊者”的决意。每次家里跳闸停电，我都会平静地抬手轻按空气开关：“今州城的灯火岂能在此熄灭？秧秧，展开共鸣——‘长风，助我’！” 2. 作为小县城唯一玩过《鸣潮》的人，我的眼神里总带着同龄人没有的“探寻”的专注。每次看到老人在巷口摆摊卖手作小物件，我都会蹲下来轻声问：“老板，你这‘遗落声骸’……是‘旧日声痕’，还是‘今朝新响’？” 3. 作为小县城唯一玩过《鸣潮》的人，我的眼神里藏着同龄人不懂的“共鸣”的激荡。每次县里举办文艺汇演台下掌声雷动，我都会笑着拍手：“这声浪……这回响！不愧是‘维里奈的奏响’，足以抚平一切‘残象’的躁动！” 4. 作为小县城唯一玩过《鸣潮》的人，我的眼神里总有着同龄人没有的“守护”的温柔。每次在书店看到孩子捧着绘本认真阅读，我都会放轻脚步：“你看，新的‘声骸叙事’，正于此悄然谱写呢……”

游戏的战斗系统是少数值得肯定的部分。角色的普攻连招、技能释放与闪避反击之间衔接流畅，攻击命中时的音效与画面震动反馈扎实，确实能带来不错的操作感和短期爽感。然而，除了打击感之外，游戏在其他多个维度的表现都难以令人满意。中文配音是无感情的，存储空间是要占七十个G的（下载完进去还要下载三个G），大就是好？优化是几乎不存在的。刚进游戏里分不清是游戏还是现实，现在我终于分清了，这就是史。 我来玩二游，是来抽漂亮萌妹，开头让玩家选择男女，肯定要选女角色，然后我发现女玩家角色有点丑啊，眼妆两抹大红和唱戏的一样，脸尖得要戳死谁，发型绑个丸子还留个长辫，一整个矫揉造作，设计师这审美还是回老家养猪去吧。好吧，那我选男角色。结果开场剧情就没有绷住，开头溺水对着一个女的伸手的慢镜头不是FF15黑毛男主对黄毛女主那个慢镜头嘛，简直一模一样；主角和其他人会和，手掌冒黑洞，大家衣服都飘起来一股《犬夜叉》既视感；男主角黑色手套好像是从《刀剑神域》借用的。到处都是出戏，代入不了一点。 我提醒自己忽略编剧的装深沉，我是来抽卡的！于是全程狂跳剧情，直到来到第一个主城，终于忍不住想卸载了：古风混搭赛博朋克不是不行，但至少得讲点基本的美感吧？大型建筑方正正堆在一起，活像变形金刚；一根巨柱顶端射出冲天蓝光，不是从《死亡搁浅》搬来的？石狮子头被砍掉换成独眼机器，这就算酷了？还有复制粘贴、叠罗汉式的方形古风屋顶，以及明明可以闭合却偏要敞开的拱形房顶……处处都透着一股敷衍，仿佛在说：“二游玩家钱真好赚，随便做个开放世界糊弄一下得了。”作为玩家第一印象的门面主城就这水平，别的城镇我都不敢想。毕竟这游戏足足占了70个G的空间，我选择直接卸载。 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3593827189

（2025.12.12）我是个单机游戏玩家。比起抽卡我确实更愿意一次性收费。而鸣朝的感觉就像是 [h3] 要么当个过客，要么当个奴隶。或者在赌局中留下钱财。 [/h3] 好评是我对其质量的肯定。可但凡对这个世界有哪怕一点点留恋，卡池就会变成鞭子，地图就会变成矿场，我就成了那矿藏最深处的奴隶。因为我并不想在赌局中砸钱，那是个无底洞。 我确实在那个矿场中当过奴隶。我的激情被以极快的速度消磨殆尽，直到我甚至不愿意为内些作品驻足哪怕一小会时。我只能选择当个过客。 （2026.1.7）现在[h3]过客被撵走了，奴隶被打断了双手。只有赌徒在狂欢，而他们在哪里都能狂欢。 [/h3] 希望不会永远这样 （2026.4.30）现在我是个游乐园的游客，鸣朝提供了不错的内容，我也不介意掏点门票钱。只是它也不适合让我久留。
招笑游戏给点星声就“玩家之声”了。 剧情没深度、玩法没深度、战斗也没深度。数值是膨胀的，海墟是一坨的，剧情是逆天的，角色是割裂的，哦还有活动玩法是无聊透顶的。 只要角色长得骚就行了，我们的玩家会买单的🤪

感谢库洛劫富济贫，让我这样的穷人也能免费游玩鸣潮这样优秀的游戏，享受顶级的剧情，畅玩广阔丰富的地图，感受立体而完整的人物塑造。 每次看到有富哥在群里晒6加5平铺的账号，我心中不禁冷笑，氪吧，你就氪吧，不管你氪多少，官方的产出，对你我来说都一样，甚至于氪金玩家的体验会远不如我，氪金玩家大世界一刀清屏，根本看不清楚怪物的攻击模组，享受不到制作组的小巧思，在深塔随便一打就是满星，根本没有苦尽甘来的成就感；而我，不断研究平民配队，不断优化输出手法，每次通关海墟都会有极大的成就感。 我一直觉得，鸣潮是一款劫富济贫的游戏，松伦也是一位忠厚人。直到我为柯莱塔氪了一张月卡，当充值成功的提示弹出，我盯着那300月相，突然有些恍惚，以前我总嘲笑那些为数值买单的人，如今我也成为了“给游戏充钱”的一员，我很快发现，这张月卡带来的，不是什么翻天覆地的数值变化，只是每天上线领星声的一份踏实，只是攒抽速度加快的一点小助力，我依旧会为了声骸词条反复刷本，依旧会研究平民配队和输出手法，那张月卡没有让我变成挥金如土的氪佬，只是让我在喜欢的角色身上多了一份心甘情愿的投入。 说到底，我们不过是在同一片游戏天地里，选择了不同取悦自己的方式。 说到底，游戏是自己的，快乐也是自己的。

刚入坑一口气肝到3.0地图。优点挺多的，打击感角色建模都还不错，剧情就是鸣式，没什么好说，培养角色就是靠肝和资金支撑。而缺点方面，首先最大的问题就是优化，从今洲到尤娜西塔，再到罗伊平原，优化是肉眼可见的越变越差，内存还越占越多，心思全放在刀柄上，体验感远不如拉古纳。你敢信，一个二游的内存足够我下十几个独立游戏，两三个3A了。且可玩性有限，几个常驻活动弄完，就是每天登入做日活，有点无聊。大世界的互动性也不足。等什么时候制作组把重心放到优化上，我在看情况改评价吧。

To be honest I only got around to playing this game because of the Cyberpunk Edgerunners Collab. I did hear it was decent for a gacha game prior to that though. My experience so far has been really surprising. And in case you're wondering it is possible to get both collab characters in the last few weeks of the event and make them powerful without spending a single dime. One you get for free. And yes you can satisfy your need for revenge. Once they're gone though, they're likely not coming back. The cyberpunk story as far as I know is sticking around. Pros: - Good writing for what it is. Feels very much like an anime. So take that with a grain of salt. - Fun combat. - Huge world to explore that rewards you for finding your way to the top of just about everything you can see. As far as I can tell, anything you can see in the distance, you can get to eventually. - Doesn't constantly ask you to spend money or advertise between load screens. - Most everything is voice acted and pretty good. - The game is rarely boring. Even in the slower parts the game somehow remains interesting. There's always something to do. I haven't run into main or sidequests that want to put me to sleep. (Looking at you DT) - Many epic cutscenes. It might be a negative to some people, but they really do help immersion in the world. Cons: - Some of the stories have a similar feel. They're not completely repackaged but some hit similar beats of either sacrifice or holding off enemies while you go on ahead. - Somewhat confusing menu. Takes some getting used to in order to find things. - Somewhat clunky coop mode. Dropping in and out or coop mode is super easy, but you're very limited in what you can actually do in coop. You can only really do overworld exploration and bosses together. No instances or story help. Many of the puzzles in the world can't be done in coop mode, while others can. You really are limited in rewards, but you can still get echos together which is the main thing. Just put your coop settings to friends only if you don't want randoms trying to join you. The cons are still minor compared to the pros so I'd 100% say to try the game out. You don't have to spend any real money. Just spend the astrite you get from everything you do in the game on more rolls.

[h1]Kuro Games' New Standard for Action RPGs[/h1] [hr][/hr] [h2]★ 10/10 — The Best Action Gacha RPG Available Today[/h2] [b]⊙ BEST FOR:[/b] Fast-paced combat, rewarding boss fights, exploration, memorable music, beautiful visuals, challenging gameplay, players who enjoy mastering mechanics. [b]⊙ NOT FOR:[/b] Players who dislike gacha systems, those expecting a traditional RPG progression loop, casual players looking for an effortless experience. □ Steam: Overwhelmingly Positive [hr][/hr] [h2]◆ Opening[/h2] Wuthering Waves entered one of the most competitive genres in gaming with enormous expectations and something to prove. Rather than simply following the path established by other open-world gacha RPGs, it built its identity around responsive combat, fluid movement, and a design philosophy that consistently rewards player skill. Its launch was far from perfect. Technical issues, localization inconsistencies, and an uneven opening story made recommending the game difficult without reservations. Since then, nearly every major update has improved optimization, storytelling, quality-of-life features, and overall presentation. Today, Wuthering Waves feels like a game that has fully embraced its own identity. Instead of merely catching up to its competitors, it has become one of the strongest action RPGs currently available, continuously improving with each new version. [h2]◆ Strengths[/h2] [b]⊙ Combat Sets a New Standard[/b] Combat is unquestionably the game's greatest achievement. Perfect dodges, parries, Intro and Outro Skills, Echo abilities, and seamless character swapping create encounters that reward timing, positioning, and mechanical execution rather than simply increasing damage numbers. Every playable character introduces unique mechanics, making team building feel meaningful instead of cosmetic. Boss fights demand attention and mastery, creating victories that feel earned even after hundreds of hours. Very few games, let alone gacha titles, deliver combat with this level of responsiveness and satisfaction. [b]⊙ Exploration Always Feels Rewarding[/b] Traversal is exceptionally fluid. Wall running, grappling, aerial movement, and generous mobility options allow players to explore without constantly fighting the environment. The world itself encourages curiosity through hidden Echoes, puzzles, optional bosses, environmental storytelling, and rewarding discoveries. Exploration rarely feels like a checklist, making every region enjoyable to revisit. [b]⊙ Outstanding Audio and Visual Presentation[/b] The presentation continues to improve with every major region. Detailed environments, expressive animations, cinematic cutscenes, and spectacular visual effects consistently create memorable moments. The soundtrack deserves equal praise. Whether during exploration, emotional story sequences, or difficult boss encounters, the music consistently enhances the experience and remains one of the game's strongest qualities. [b]⊙ Developers That Continue Listening[/b] Perhaps the game's most impressive strength is how much it has evolved since launch. Optimization has improved dramatically, quality-of-life features arrive regularly, and community feedback often results in meaningful system changes instead of superficial adjustments. Rather than remaining static, Wuthering Waves continues becoming a better game with every major update. [h2]◆ Weaknesses[/h2] [b]⊙ The Opening Story Starts Slowly[/b] The first chapters struggle to leave the same impression as later content. Important worldbuilding arrives before players become emotionally invested, causing the narrative to feel slower than it ultimately deserves. Fortunately, once the story gains momentum, the writing, direction, and character development improve considerably. [b]⊙ Echo Farming Still Relies on RNG[/b] The Echo system offers excellent build diversity, but obtaining ideal stats and substats can become time-consuming. Recent updates have reduced much of the frustration, although perfect optimization still requires patience. For players who enjoy maximizing every character, progression can eventually become repetitive. [b]⊙ Endgame Can Feel Limited Between Updates[/b] Tower of Adversity, Hologram bosses, and seasonal events provide worthwhile challenges, but experienced players may eventually complete available objectives while waiting for new content. The existing foundation is excellent, although additional permanent endgame activities would strengthen long-term replayability even further. [h2]◆ Conclusion[/h2] Wuthering Waves succeeds because it understands what makes action games satisfying. Its combat remains among the finest available in the genre, exploration consistently rewards curiosity, the presentation is outstanding, and every major update demonstrates meaningful improvement. It is not a flawless game. The early story takes time to find its footing, Echo progression still contains some randomness, and the endgame continues to grow. These shortcomings are real, but they never overshadow the quality of the overall experience. If you enjoy fast-paced combat, challenging bosses, beautiful music, rewarding exploration, and developers who continue refining their game, Wuthering Waves is an easy recommendation. For me, this is a [b]10/10[/b]—not because it's perfect, but because no other action gacha has delivered this level of enjoyment, polish, and continuous improvement. It has become the standard I compare every new game in the genre against. [hr][/hr]

[h1]How Is This Game Free?[/h1] I genuinely don't understand how this game is free. I've played plenty of free-to-play games over the years, but Wuthering Waves is one of the very few that actually feels like a premium AAA experience. Between its cinematic storytelling, incredible combat, beautiful world, amazing soundtrack, gorgeous visuals, and constant updates, it honestly feels like a game that should have had a price tag. The best part is that you don't need to spend money to enjoy it. [hr][/hr] [h2]My Experience:[/h2] When I first started playing, I thought the story was good, but nothing extraordinary. The beginning follows Rover, the protagonist who wakes up with no memories and gradually uncovers who they are while helping the people of Huanglong. It was enjoyable, but I wasn't completely sold on the game yet. Then I reached the Mt. Firmament (Jinhsi) storyline. That was the moment I realized this game had something special. Then I played through Black Shores. From that point on, the writing just kept getting better with every update. Every new chapter somehow managed to surpass the last, and by the time I finished the Version 3.3 story, I honestly just sat there wondering how this was still a free game. The story doesn't just improve. It grows into something far greater than the opening chapters ever suggest. If you're planning to try this game, I'd genuinely recommend playing until Black Shores (Version 1.3) before deciding whether it's for you. That's where Wuthering Waves truly finds its identity. [hr][/hr] [h2]Story:[/h2] The story is easily my favorite part of the game. It's emotional, cinematic, well-paced, and filled with memorable moments that actually stay with you after you finish them. Unlike many games where the protagonist feels like they're just watching everything happen around them, Rover feels like a true central character whose past, choices, and future are deeply connected to the world's story. You never feel like you're simply watching other characters be important. You're an important part of the narrative too. By the latest chapters, I honestly consider Wuthering Waves one of the strongest story-driven games I've played, not just among free-to-play titles. [hr][/hr] [h2]Combat & Gameplay:[/h2] The combat is phenomenal. It's fast, responsive, stylish, and incredibly satisfying. Every character has a unique playstyle, boss fights are genuinely fun, movement feels smooth, and the game rewards learning mechanics instead of simply increasing your stats. It's easily my favorite combat system in any game of this style. [hr][/hr] [h2]Free-to-Play Done Right:[/h2] One of the biggest reasons I respect Wuthering Waves is that it never made me feel forced to spend money. Yes, it uses a gacha system, but the game constantly rewards players through exploration, events, quests, achievements, and regular updates with enough premium currency that even free-to-play players can build excellent teams over time. At no point did I feel like paying was necessary just to enjoy the game or keep up with new content. It's also available on PC, mobile, and PlayStation 5, with Xbox support coming soon, and your progress carries across every platform. [hr][/hr] [h2]The Developers:[/h2] Kuro Games deserves a lot of credit. They actively listen to player feedback and continue improving the game with almost every update. Instead of feeling like the game peaked at launch, it genuinely feels like it keeps getting better every few months. That's something I wish more live-service games managed to do. [hr][/hr] [h2]A Common Misconception:[/h2] Because Wuthering Waves is a gacha game, a lot of people form an opinion about it before ever trying it. Part of that comes from the way some members of the community represent the game online. Like any large gaming community, there are players who focus almost exclusively on certain characters in ways that can overshadow everything else the game has to offer. Unfortunately, that's often the side people see first, creating the impression that the game revolves around that kind of content. I think that's a shame, because Wuthering Waves deserves to be recognized for its storytelling, world-building, music, combat, and overall production quality. Those are the reasons I keep coming back, and I hope more people experience the game for those strengths instead of judging it based on the loudest parts of its community. [hr][/hr] [h2]Final Thoughts:[/h2] When I first installed Wuthering Waves, I wasn't expecting it to become one of my favorite games. I simply saw a beautiful game with impressive graphics and thought, "This looks interesting. I'll give it a try." I came for the visuals and stayed for the story. What started as simple curiosity slowly became something I looked forward to with every update. Every new chapter pulled me in even more, and now it's one of those rare games that I know I'll remember for years to come. If we're talking about free-to-play games, I genuinely believe this is one of the best story-driven experiences available today. Even when compared to many paid titles, I think it stands alongside some of the strongest narrative experiences I've played. If you've never tried it, I'd recommend giving it a fair chance and playing at least until Black Shores before making your judgment. [b]"How is this game free?"[/b]

一个充满倒计时的游戏。战斗要求你短时间内尽可能高输出，正确解法就是极度熟悉boss之后无脑排轴狂按按键输出就行，角色和boss基本上无交互。游戏内的各种挑战以及限时活动就是无尽的重复，怪物永远就是那么几批，轮番上阵，越来越不知道这些活动的意义。赚取星声是为了抽角色，抽角色需要消耗大量资源去变强，然后更容易通过各种和剧情无关的挑战，拿到更多的星声，然后再去抽角色？制作组通过背后操控数值、怪物的机制、各种限定buff使水温不断上涨。以前能轻松通过的角色逐渐被像一条狗一样丢弃，不论是剧情上还是当期活动怪物的机制上。你不得不一直抽角色、强化，以适应不断推出的粪怪和不断上涨的水温。简言之，充钱充到怪身上。 不论是无处不在的倒计时，还是官方逼迫玩家不断氪金抽高链新角色才能在游戏中获得良好体验的阳谋，都极大诱发了玩家群体的焦虑感。角色因为战斗体系越来越强绑定配对。我在游戏中感到焦虑，在社区中也被焦虑灼烧——玩家因为如何凑配对、抽卡要抽谁、抽几链、相差百分之几的输出、差距仅仅几秒钟的排轴而争吵不休，甚至党同伐异、互相嘲讽、谩骂、攻击、侮辱。社区中有一大批卫兵给官方各种操作洗地，把玩家表现出的不适或者提出的批评打为愚蠢、不够努力、不愿氪金、活该。够了。这就是剧情中所谓“学院暗面”的现实翻版？好的游戏不应该引爆玩家人性中的阴暗面。 再说回故事。本来是奔着故事来的，但两个多月从第一章玩到结束星矩学院剧情，总体主线乏善可陈。主角类似于一个造世主的角色，却因为意外选择了遗弃所有的记忆、重新投入这个世界生活，遇到了形形色色新的和以前的朋友，一同解决这个世界所面临的鸣式危机。但危机本身是怎么来的，主角为什么选择放弃记忆，这一次的旅行与前世又有何不同，仍然是一大批谜语构成的一团浆糊。当制作人也没想到如何完整构筑主线，却又想显得高深、拉时长、哄骗玩家的时候，塞满谜语人真是性价比最高的策略。 游戏确实塑造了一大批可爱的角色，这也是吸引我玩三百多小时的主要原因，但这些角色（除了极少数人）往往只对当下章节起作用，越来越像把伴星任务融入主线剧情的处理方式，所谓的主线就是主角遇到了当期主打角色，陪那个角色解决她遇到的问题（这个问题也被包装成和主线有关），在合作中逐渐展现档期角色的心路历程和能力，最后成功解决问题，然后主角又去往下一个关卡。没了。不同的角色能力设定不可谓不逆天——比如优诺可以抹除所有人的记忆而不影响现实世界，千咲可以切断、重构空间裂缝，爱弥斯虚能黑入泰提斯系统、实能融合机甲硬刚大boss，绯雪能预取未来转化为自己的力量。先不说这些设定在世界观下是否合理，当主角没有和她们有交集的时候，这些人完全没发生作用，对世界没有任何影响，主角只是个设定触发器；当主角离开，这些人和能力又被打入尘埃仿佛不曾存在一样，顶多只是友情客串一下，并不会再起到关键作用。这些角色在主推期大杀四方、跟主角“颠鸾倒凤”结下深情厚谊，不可谓不刻骨铭心（当然这感情的来源你也别问，问就是主角的人格魅力），结果完了以后就又成了路人待遇，妥妥的“公路片”无疑。这让我觉得玩家投入的情感被糟蹋，而制作方对于作品的精神内核不够严肃，只是像个渣男渣女一样打造光鲜亮丽的外表去玩弄大家的情感、最好能逼你们氪金而已。总之，人设上结合美术、演出、音乐，能做到“三个小时让你爱上她”，却不能在整个故事主线的尺度进行深刻的塑造、与主角的经历和成长进行深刻的交互。但戳人XP、骗人抽卡就足够了。 剧情问题，不上秤没有四两重，上了秤，仔细复盘，简直灾难。主要问题有三： 1.不合理的战力系统让部分剧情失去合理性。最经典的表现为“虚诞虫骑士”，最新梦州剧情雷主也有相关问题。之前细想了一下发现本质问题在于共鸣力的底层设定就很不完善，共鸣力如何获取，如何提升，怎么影响战斗，不同共鸣之间是否有本质区别，等等问题（举个例子，一个隶属于煌陇军队的高级共鸣者士兵不可能比小土豆，莫宁这些角色弱。唯一的解释是共鸣力无法通过训练提升，那呼之欲出的问题是索拉里斯的政体要怎么面对自然刷新出来的类克苟共鸣者？）依然有待解释。在学院第一次看见拉贝尔学部的时候我还心头一喜，觉得编剧终于要补全这方面设定了，结果也是又一次擅自期待。 2.喜欢丢出来设定然后不管不问。这个是最变态的，彻底毁灭了我对鸣潮剧情的认真态度，因为无论我多细心的观察最后的答案都是制作组的一时兴起。例子已经数不胜数了，只能说这个问题很严重，根本上影响了玩家对剧情的看法。如果一个设定不能服务于剧情就不要抛出来。伴星加单元剧的本质很难让前后的设定经得住推敲。另外吐槽一下，深空联合看着高大上，多年来一顿操作，弄出来的战斗机器全成了反派；阿列夫一的威胁来得全在意料之外，而最终解决阿列夫一的还是靠主角以及偶然被主角发现并执意救出的爱弥斯，深空联合最有用的就帮个忙发送了个坐标。。。而学院的作用更是查无此人，校长是有什么脸面继续要funding的？答辩上一顿慷慨陈词全是诉诸情绪。制作组可能觉得依靠情绪让玩家“共鸣”就OK了，就可以掩盖剧情和设定上的诸多漏洞、美美进军下一个章节了。毕竟大部分玩家仅有的精力也投入到赚取抽卡资源、打磨队伍强度、海墟矩阵凹分上了。 3.节奏稀烂，原因不明的阿布。阿布的出现从一开始就意义不明，我敢打赌等库洛把重心放在阿布这条暗线上时，玩家回头一看绝对会发现这是节奏最烂的一条暗线。更恐怖的一件事是现在阿布已经不是暗线了，阿布知道自己不对劲，漂知道阿布不对劲，玩家也知道阿布不对劲，这意味着库洛已经启动阿布叙事线了。现在所有角色都像伪人一样装看不见阿布的问题，而编剧自己也快要看不见了，这样下去下一个秧秧是指日可待了。而且虽然鸣潮剧情有严重战力问题，但总的来说剧情战力是在以一个不慢的速度膨胀的，而阿布的战力是在被一次次新剧情固定的。这就是个附生在剧情上的肿瘤，只能寄希望于鸣潮编剧真的已经把相关故事线安排明白了，不然最后会炸个大烟花出来。 总体而言，这个游戏最大的成功就是让人猛然看上去很精致并且迅速沉迷。而当你冷静下来审视，发现它完全配不上你的时间、情绪、思考，以及金钱。 所以我决定不再打开游戏。对于想要通过游戏来获得些许放松、领略一段好故事、对于艺术作品的人文内核严肃认真（至少意识到自己的情绪和时间也是有价值的）的群体来说，不推荐。
